entries.description: Reviewed the accepted distributor baseline, accepted multi-organization security baseline, current app/test proof surfaces, and downstream Phase 2 specs for app-coverage-conformance Session 1.
Created the app coverage and conformance review ledger with the current proof matrix, conformance gaps, and recommended next proof layers.
Created the seam-refactor plan that prioritizes API-first admin/shell cleanup, order-detail state extraction, and navigation-provider test seams.
Recorded the conservative queue verdict: no downstream spec edits now, no new cross-set overlap, and only disjoint intra-set proof work after Session 1 artifacts are frozen.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. The build was blocked by file locks on running AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web-related outputs, while dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build passed with 394 total tests.
Ran external session verification against the Session 1 spec, created artifacts, and validation summary, and saved the raw verifier output.
Refactored the admin user-management page and order-detail page to use app-facing service seams instead of web-tier database orchestration and page-local workflow coordination.
Added API-backed organization-option loading plus a shell session-state loader so MainLayout now resolves organization-switcher state through explicit service boundaries.
Added the organization-options API seam and strengthened focused API/web guardrail tests so the app enforces API-first admin and shell boundaries.
Documented the Session 2 architecture cleanup, including the new admin, shell, and order-detail seams that Session 3 should target directly.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. Both hit existing file-lock contention from running sample, API, web, and Playwright outputs, but targeted no-build verification still passed for tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests (8 tests) and tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests (23 tests).
Ran external session verification against the Session 2 spec, changed code, architecture note, and build/test summary, and saved the raw verifier output.

Added direct unit coverage for OrderDetailState, ShellSessionStateLoader, and AcmeCoffeeNavigationDataProvider using lightweight HTTP/auth test doubles so the app-specific workflow, claim-mapping, and navigation-filter seams are proven without browser dependence.

Expanded AdminUserScopeTests to cover dual-membership organization-options behavior, invalid authenticated user IDs, scoped user-admin revocation inside the active organization, and unauthorized revocation attempts outside the active scope.

Added bUnit-based UserManagement page proof with MudBlazor providers so the API-driven admin scope banner, scoped user rendering, grant action refresh, and warning-state UI are covered directly at the component layer.

Used routed analysis to keep Session 3 focused on unit, integration, and targeted component proof instead of piling more browser-host coverage onto seams that are already failing in the broader runtime baseline.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully. Targeted Session 3 verification passed for 25 new/updated web tests and 8 admin-scope API tests, while dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln still reports pre-existing AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web and Playwright runtime 500 failures on home, customer, and admin routes.
Ran external session verification against the Session 3 spec, changed tests, and build/test summary, saved the raw verifier output, and received a VERIFIED verdict.
